description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier class, which serves as a central component for sanitizing and filtering HTML content to ensure it is safe and standards-compliant. It includes methods for purifying individual snippets or arrays of HTML strings, managing configuration, and applying various filtering strategies.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier
classes.description: Main class that coordinates the HTML sanitization process, managing configuration, filtering strategies, and the purification workflow. Implements singleton pattern for global access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an HTMLPurifier instance with optional configuration.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a custom filter object to the purification process (deprecated use configuration directives).

methods.name: purify
methods.description: Cleans a single HTML string by parsing, filtering, and generating sanitized HTML output.

methods.name: purifyArray
methods.description: Purifies an array of HTML strings, returning an array of sanitized HTML.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of HTMLPurifier, creating it if necessary.
